original_ai_output.title_zh: 洪水致南苏丹坦布拉流离失所者处境艰难
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州坦布拉县连日暴雨引发洪水，多个流离失所者营地被淹，简易住所受损，部分家庭被迫转移至高地。当地居民与官员称，洪水加剧了食品短缺、医疗与教育服务匮乏等问题，营地内一加仑木薯售价约6000南苏丹镑。居民呼吁提供食品、药品、住所及改善排水等紧急援助。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹坦布拉县多个流离失所者营地遭洪水淹没
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Heavy rain on Tuesday flooded several IDP camps, damaging makeshift shelters and forcing some families to move to higher ground.

key_facts.fact: 洪水加剧食品短缺、医疗与教育服务匮乏
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Flooding, food shortages and limited access to healthcare and education are worsening conditions for internally displaced people (IDPs) in Tambura County

key_facts.fact: 三个帕亚姆15个营地的家庭难以获得食品和基本援助
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: families in 15 camps across three payams were struggling to access food and other basic assistance

key_facts.fact: 一加仑木薯售价约6000南苏丹镑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a gallon of cassava selling for about 6,000 South Sudanese pounds

key_facts.fact: 居民呼吁提供食品、药品、住所及改善排水等紧急援助
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Residents are calling for urgent assistance, including food, medicines, shelter and improved drainage.

key_facts.fact: 坦布拉县自2021年族群冲突升级以来长期存在暴力与流离失所问题
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Tambura County has experienced years of violence and displacement, particularly since intercommunal fighting escalated in 2021

uncertainties: 报道为单一来源（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
积水可能加剧卫生状况恶化并增加疟疾等疾病风险，属居民警告，尚未证实
9月居民报告担心SPLA-IO部队可能发动袭击，该担忧尚未证实
